text:
As far as dental care goes, I had a truly excellent experience with Dr. Noon and this dental office. From the moment I arrived, everything felt clean, professional, and well-organized.

Dr. Noon has incredibly gentle hands. She consistently checked in with me to make sure I was comfortable and feeling no pain. This was actually the first dental experience I’ve ever had without any pain injections or numbing agents, which was remarkable. Right now, just half an hour out of my appointment it doesn’t feel like I had a dentist visit.  The appointment felt efficient, calm, and very respectful.

After years of uncertainty about dental care and being told by previous dentists that work would be expensive- it was such a relief to hear her say that my teeth and gums are healthy. I did want her help addressing a small pocket that tends to trap food, and she fully supported that concern. She made sure I felt heard, understood, and involved in the decision-making.

Even with a bit of a language barrier, Dr. Noon made a genuine effort to ensure that we understood each other clearly, which made a huge difference. Dental care is very personal, and she created an experience that felt safe and respectful rather than stressful.

I don’t often leave reviews, but I chose this office because of the reviews- and they were accurate. Reviews matter, especially for something as personal as dental work. I will absolutely be returning and will be recommending this office to my family.

Thank you, Dr. Noon, for such a positive experience.

text:
I visited this dental clinic last week while travelling in Bangkok for a few days due to a cracked tooth. Prior to my trip, I had already seen a dentist in my home country and was referred to an endodontist, but I wasn’t able to get an appointment until much later in February.
I contacted the clinic via Line and was impressed by how promptly they responded. I was able to book an appointment on the same day. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and professional.
The dentist who examined me (I regret that I’ve forgotten his name) was incredibly warm, thorough, and honest. Because I was in Bangkok for a short time and my situation would likely require either a root canal or an extraction, he advised that it would be better to have the treatment done back at home where follow-up care would be easier and more seamless. He explained that it wouldn’t be a simple process and prioritised my long-term safety and outcome rather than pushing for treatment while I was travelling.
I really appreciated his integrity and professionalism. Even though I didn’t end up having treatment done there, I felt genuinely cared for and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for honest, patient-focused dental care in Bangkok.
